fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
At $516, it needs Clementine's approval by email

Tavish Moffatt runs a 6-person crew at Henneberg Landscaping. Before spring cleanups he asks for safety vests, pruning shears, and work gloves, a request that totals $516.00. Anything over $500 waits for operations manager Clementine Szabo-Reyes, who approves it from an email. Smaller requests go to the buyer.

fieldData.awb---how-to-description: Seven steps to create an occupational therapy intake form that shows the therapist what is hard for each patient before the evaluation.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-1-des: Read back through recent evaluations and write down the tasks patients came in unable to do, such as bathing, buttoning a shirt, chopping vegetables, or getting in and out of a car. That list becomes the checklist on the first screen.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-2-des: Adults answer for themselves, and a parent answers for a young child. Add a Completed by question at the top. The therapist then knows whose view each answer gives.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-3-des: A clinic that sees both children and drivers needs different questions for each. Put them in separate sections and show a section only when the earlier answers call for it. Nobody scrolls past questions meant for someone else.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Leave the goal questions open. "Lift my granddaughter" tells the therapist more than a box marked shoulder strength, and the patient recognizes the goal when it comes back at re-evaluation.
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-5-des: Put the sections and the rules for when each one opens into one prompt. Emergent builds the intake form and the database behind it. Ask in plain English when a question needs rewording later.
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-6-des: Have the chart open on the tasks the patient marked as hard, with the goals under them. The therapist can read it in the few minutes before the evaluation instead of paging through a packet.
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-7-des: Fill in the form once as the parent of a 4-year-old and check that the school section stays closed. Then fill it in as an adult with the referring physician left blank, and look for that intake on the front desk list.
